name: Transmuting
description: Sneak right clicking an [effect:block][dark-gray]appropriate resource block[/dark-gray][/effect] attunes to it. Mining other [effect:block][dark-gray]appropriate blocks[/dark-gray][/effect] converts their drops into those of the attuned block at the [effect:equiv][dark-gray]equivalent exchange[/dark-gray][/effect] rate.

effects.explanation:
Pickaxes: All ores except Emerald and Ancient Debris.
Axes: All Logs.
Shovels: Mycelium, Podzol, Clay, Rooted Dirt, Red Sand, Soul Sand, Gravel, and Mud.
Shears: All Leaves.

For example, a Diamond sells for 8x as much as a Raw Gold, so mining Gole Ore while attuned to Diamond Ore has a 1/8 chance to drop a diamond, while mining Diamond Ore while attuned to Gold Ore drops 8 Raw Gold.
